recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中嗜酸性系細胞明顯增多，可見大量含橘紅色顆粒的成熟及未成熟嗜酸性球（嗜酸性骨髓球），部分未成熟細胞混有深紫色顆粒；原始細胞並未明顯增加，符合 HES 骨髓的嗜酸性增生。
features: Marked increase in eosinophilic lineage cells at all stages of maturation
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and orange-red granules
Some immature eosinophils contain admixed dark purple (basophilic-appearing) granules
Mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and abundant specific granules
Occasional larger mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and scattered erythroid precursors; blasts not obviously increased
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a striking increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes and metamyelocytes with orange-red granules, some with admixed dark purple immature granules. Occasional larger mononuclear cells and erythroid precursors are present; blasts do not appear substantially increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marked eosinophilic hyperplasia; idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome is a diagnosis of exclusion requiring blast count, cytogenetics, FISH/RT-PCR for PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 and JAK2 rearrangements, mast cell assessment and T-cell clonality studies.

ddx.vs: May look identical, often with increased spindled mast cells; confirmed by detection of FIP1L1::PDGFRA.
Requires evidence of clonality or increased blasts with dysplasia, which morphology alone in this field does not show.
Shows abnormal eosinophils with large purple-violet granules plus increased myelomonocytic blasts (≥20% or diagnostic genetics).
Features spindle-shaped, CD25/CD117-positive mast cell aggregates and KIT D816V mutation.
